title: Women's Rights Guide
description: A comprehensive guide to understand your rights as a woman in India. Covers constitutional rights, legal protections, and available remedies.

title: Policy Advocacy Toolkit
description: Step-by-step guide to engaging in policy advocacy and democratic participation. Includes templates and strategies for effective advocacy.

title: Leadership Development Workbook
description: Interactive workbook for developing leadership skills and community organizing. Features exercises, case studies, and reflection prompts.

title: Research Report: Women in Politics
description: Detailed research on women's representation in political institutions. Includes data visualization, analysis, and policy recommendations.

title: Harassment Laws Explained
description: Understanding workplace and sexual harassment laws and how to file complaints. Covers legal frameworks and procedures.

title: Community Organizing Guide
description: Practical guide to grassroots organizing and community mobilization. Includes action planning templates and best practices.

title: Gender and Constitutional Rights
description: Overview of constitutional provisions protecting women's rights. Includes case studies and jurisprudence analysis.

title: Youth Activism Handbook
description: Guide for young activists to engage in social movements. Covers digital activism, offline organizing, and self-care.
